target: WFP monthly actual price (NGN per source unit); NBS targets separate and not trained
split: chronological 70/15/15; model-specific usable target rows; shared validation/test dates within each series

models.xgboost: 250 trees; depth=2; learning_rate=0.03; subsample=0.9; colsample_bytree=0.9; seed=42
models.gradient_boosting: 120 estimators; depth=2; learning_rate=0.03; Huber loss; seed=42
models.stacking: Random Forest + XGBoost + Gradient Boosting; Ridge meta-model from expanding-window training-only OOF predictions
models.lstm: Input(12,1) -> LSTM(16) -> Dropout(0.10) -> Dense(1); Adam(0.001); MSE; early stopping patience 15
models.naive_last_observation: actual previous calendar-month price; no substitute prior observation across gaps

notes: Only normalized WFP/NBS data were read; no raw data modified.
No target interpolation, forward-fill, cross-source aggregation, or unit conversion was performed.
All generated forecasts are historical-only and are not current November 2026 market prices.
